name: chatcut-video-editor
description: Creates and edits production-ready videos in ChatCut through an editable timeline.

displayDescription.en: Create and edit videos with natural language: import footage, refine talking-head videos, add captions, generate editable motion graphics, voiceovers, and music, then export while keeping the timeline editable.
displayDescription.zh: 用自然语言完成专业视频剪辑：导入素材、精剪口播、添加字幕、生成MG动画、配音配乐并导出成片，保留可编辑时间线

defaultInitPrompt.en: Edit this talking-head video for a tighter story with captions, B-roll, music, and motion graphics.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 创意精剪这段口播，优化叙事节奏，并添加字幕、B-roll、音乐和MG动画

quickPrompts.en: Edit this talking-head video for a tighter story with captions, B-roll, music, and motion graphics.
quickPrompts.zh: 创意精剪这段口播，优化叙事节奏，并添加字幕、B-roll、音乐和MG动画

quickPrompts.en: Create an AI video-editing explainer with motion graphics and an English voiceover.
quickPrompts.zh: 制作一条讲解AI如何改变视频剪辑的MG动画视频，并添加英文旁白

quickPrompts.en: Turn this footage into 10 TikTok and Reels clips with captions, motion graphics, and thumbnails.
quickPrompts.zh: 将这份素材剪成10条TikTok和Reels短视频，添加字幕、MG动画，并为每条制作封面
